messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT: p95 latency spike detected for model-service-usw2 (serving-pool-7). Alert threshold breached (x3 baseline) at 2026-03-16T22:10:00Z. Pager: @alice (oncall)

alice: Acked. I'm on it, pulling dashboards now.

bob: seeing p50 ~120ms -> 140ms, p95 jumped from 420ms to 2.1s across the pool. All replicas in usw2-1.

carol: any recent kernel or node updates in that pool?

alice: There was a kernel patch rollout yesterday 03:00 UTC on usw2-1 pool, batch 3/5. I'll check rollout status.

dave: customer-facing: a couple enterprise customers reported slow responses starting ~21:58 UTC, some autogenerated retries. No errors, just timeouts at client-side.

alice: mitigation: scaling to 2x replicas and enabling model-fallback to quantized variant for latency-sensitive routes. Doing canary now.

frank: sharing quick trace snippet from trace-collector (filtered to long spans):

```
span id=0x7f3a duration=1.98s service=model-inference
  -> cpu_wait (syscall) 1.2s
  -> io_wait (block) 0.6s
  -> kv_cache_miss 160ms
tags: node=ip-10-0-45-67,pid=4121
```

bob: interesting — span shows long syscall wait. Could be kernel blocking (futex or pagefaults). Carol, can you pull perf counters for those hosts?

carol: running `sudo perf stat -a -e context-switches,page-faults,cpu-cycles -p 4121 sleep 5` on a suspect host now. results will be pasted.

carol: perf output snippet:

```
Performance counter stats for 'sleep 5':
   11,234 context-switches
    8,901 page-faults
  2,345,678,901 cpu-cycles
  0.48 secs time elapsed
```

alice: page-faults looks elevated vs baseline (~200). That aligns with trace cpu_wait. Could be a paging/oom-swap interaction after kernel change.

bob: grabbing kernel dmesg on one host: `grep -i "oom\|swapper\|page fault" /var/log/kern.log | tail -n 50` — found repeated softirq/page reclaim logs around 21:56-22:05.

frank: uploaded aggregated logs+traces to s3: https://s3.redwood.internal/incident-2123456789/artifacts.zip (contains perf, dmesg, traces).

dave: customer impact estimate: ~4 customers hit tail latency >1s for ~20 minutes, some automatic retries increased error rates downstream. Flagging for postmortem customer comms.

carol: hypothesis A: recent kernel scheduler change increased reclaim latency under our continuous-batching workload -> p95 spike. Hypothesis B: a regression in page cache reclaim path triggered by a driver change.

alice: running live mitigations: 1) pinning inference processes to isolated cpus on a suspect host, 2) toggling swappiness to 10 via sysctl, 3) temporarily disabling background reclaim (cmk override) on canary. We'll monitor p95.

bob: logs show p95 dropping to ~600ms on canary after CPU pinning + fallback. Not back to baseline but improved.

frank: requested kernel rollback for the remaining nodes in the pool (change ticket #CR-4217). Ops scheduled immediate rollback window.

alice: collecting timeline for RCA:
- 21:45 UTC: kernel rollout batch starts (batch 3 on usw2-1)
- 21:56 UTC: first p95 deviations detected in metrics (pagerbot alert)
- 21:58 UTC: customers report slow responses
- 22:03 UTC: perf/dmesg/trace collection initiated
- 22:12 UTC: mitigation applied (scale & quantized fallback)
- 22:20 UTC: canary shows partial recovery after CPU pinning

carol: next steps: gather full perf samples (`perf record -F 99 -a -g -- sleep 10`) from affected hosts, bpftrace for futex/wait syscalls, and kernel oops scan. I'll drop results to the S3 artifacts.

bob: adding a note to incident timeline: confirm whether all nodes in batch 3 received the same kernel variant (possible config drift).

dave: will prepare a short customer-facing update: impacted customers, what we did, and ETA for full rollback.

alice: assigning owners: RCA lead = carol, mitigation lead = alice, customer comms = dave, rollback ops = frank. I'll turn this into a post-incident channel once stabilized.

frank: incident bot: STATUS update: p95 currently 520ms (global), impacted hosts 4 -> 1 after rollback partial. Next update in 10m or on important changes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

bob: thanks team. Keep sharing logs to the artifacts bundle and update the timeline as you collect more evidence.

carol: dropping bpftrace snippet for futex wait traces (live):

```
bpftrace -e 'tracepoint:syscalls:sys_enter_futex { @[comm] = count(); }'

Top:
  inference (12345)  ->  8,742
  worker (22311)     ->  6,111
```

carol: that reinforces heavy futex waits in inference processes. attaching full output to S3.

alice: ok. converting to live RCA coordination thread. We'll maintain this thread for timeline/hypothesis updates. Good work so far. :thumbsup:
